name: New Prairie Solar
old_description: We are primarily a general contractor focused on exceptional customer service. We avoid cold calling and aggressive sales, allowing you to approach us at your convenience for education and guidance. From initial contact through post-installation monitoring and servicing, your solar PV system will be handled by our in-house solar and construction teams, in partnership with our long-standing preferred licensed electrician. Our in-house designers, technicians and installers will find the best placement and size for your array, prioritizing quality and aesthetics, with no shortcuts taken. We will walk you through available incentives and ensure you receive outlined information in an easy-to-read contract.  We will complete your installation in a timely manner and offer a genuine guarantee for your system’s lifespan.
about:
New Prairie Solar operates from Urbana, Illinois, as the solar division of New Prairie Construction, a company established in 1988. The construction firm expanded into solar photovoltaics to meet demand for a reliable local provider in Central Illinois. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, installs, and services solar PV systems for residential, commercial, agricultural, and nonprofit clients. Its in-house team includes designers, technicians, and installers who handle array placement, sizing, and aesthetics, while partnering with a preferred licensed electrician for electrical work. New Prairie Solar also offers energy storage solutions and energy efficiency services, guiding customers through incentives and rebates with clear contracts.

The firm serves homeowners, businesses, farms, and nonprofit organizations throughout the Greater Urbana-Champaign area. Its portfolio includes projects for local residents and agricultural operations, with testimonials highlighting meticulous workmanship.

New Prairie Solar distinguishes itself through its construction heritage, applying building science knowledge to solar installations. It avoids cold calling, emphasizes customer education, and provides a lifetime guarantee on installed systems, backed by long-term service and monitoring.
